steps: Require the separate CSP decision before any header change. Re-read the actual Connect site/root and current index/config/header by the official path.
Save the exact current index and hosting configuration bytes/hash in a private rollback directory; never use a main-site workflow.
Verify every local export file hash. Preserve public config semantics, robots, security headers and all existing immutable assets.
Upload only new immutable JS/CSS/assets first through the existing official Connect-scoped hosting flow; read back exact hashes.
Apply only the approved Connect img-src addition while preserving other directives, using the separately reviewed host configuration snapshot.
Switch index last; verify served index/asset hashes and version33, then browser smoke.
Compare main-site baseline before/after. On uncertain write, read back rather than repeat. Keep previous immutable assets.
rollback: Restore the exact saved Connect index via the same official Connect-scoped flow.
Restore the exact prior Connect hosting configuration/CSP only if it changed in this deployment.
Re-read index/config/header hashes and previous version. Never delete media/database rows or change other sites/services.
notice: Historical publication checklist, not an instruction to deploy again. Private rollback/config backups and hosting execution details are not published.
